name: Tonga
note: Completed facilities operate automatically when their inputs, power and operating funds are available. Output and spending are dated receipts; goods are inventory, not treasury cash. Support upgrades provide their stated capabilities and are not separate pack producers. Actual value added is recorded in the province economy, without a second completion or sales bonus. Construction funding and operating purchases remain distinct uses of the annual capital budget.

power.note: Sum of displayed facility power receipts on the stated date only. Excludes earlier receipts and activities without saved power use; this is not total national consumption.

sites.effect: Paid fractional processing capacity, with matching power and operating inputs. No stock is granted.

lifecycle.installed_note: Installed capacity includes all completed additions at this site. Older saves do not retain each building's completion date or paid contract history; none is reconstructed. Finishing construction is not proof of staffed output or a second GDP award.

operation.label: Recorded province operation
operation.note: Actual output, worker use and operating charges on the recorded date. Current capacity or shortages do not rewrite this receipt. Charges belong to the existing fiscal settlement, not a second bill.
operation.reason: Missing bauxite for the complete operating bundle.

readiness.label: Blocked for current work
readiness.note: Operating inputs or storage limit output; replenish raw stocks and intermediate packs, or use finished inventory. This is current readiness; only a dated receipt proves operation.

requirements.label: Qualified staffing
requirements.note: Coverage of the required qualifications. Assigned people are shared with other employers; these are not newly created workers.

requirements.label: Power and local grid
requirements.note: Current utility support; actual dispatch is shared with other operating facilities.

requirements.label: Operating inputs and storage
requirements.note: Raw materials, intermediate goods and finished-goods room required for operation. They are not construction requirements.

requirements.label: Operating department funds
requirements.note: Conditional current operating authorization. Availability is neither cash already spent nor a payment guarantee.

requirements.label: bauxite operating input
requirements.note: Required for one full operating day at installed capacity; available is shared national inventory, not a daily delivery or a reservation. Actual operation may be lower. Construction does not require this input.

requirements.label: coal operating input
requirements.note: Required for one full operating day at installed capacity; available is shared national inventory, not a daily delivery or a reservation. Actual operation may be lower. Construction does not require this input.

requirements.label: iron operating input
requirements.note: Required for one full operating day at installed capacity; available is shared national inventory, not a daily delivery or a reservation. Actual operation may be lower. Construction does not require this input.

requirements.label: National generating support
requirements.note: Required per full installed operating day, compared with total modeled support. Capacity is shared with other consumers; this does not reserve power or report historical dispatch.

requirements.label: Local grid support
requirements.note: Required per full installed operating day, compared with total modeled support. Capacity is shared with other consumers; this does not reserve power or report historical dispatch.

requirements.label: Facility operating authority
requirements.note: Rated charge for one full installed operating day at current contractor terms. Available is current department spending authority, not Treasury cash or a payment already made; actual work may be lower.

requirements.label: Generating service authority
requirements.note: Rated charge for one full installed operating day at current contractor terms. Available is current department spending authority, not Treasury cash or a payment already made; actual work may be lower.

staffing.label: Current workforce and recorded use
staffing.note: Assigned workers come from the population ledger's dated workforce match. Qualified staffing coverage is current feasible coverage of installed job requirements; workers used belong to the separate operating receipt date.
